notes.loon: DOMAIN-REGEX is omitted because Loon remote rules do not support it. Remote filters name their subscription sources explicitly. Single-label hostnames have no native switch; skip-proxy covers the local suffixes only.
notes.shadowrocket: DOMAIN-REGEX is omitted for compatibility. The lan single-label hostname regex is replaced by the native exclude-simple-hostnames.
notes.surge: DOMAIN-REGEX is unsupported and omitted; the lan single-label hostname regex is replaced by the native exclude-simple-hostnames. Native url-test groups allow temporary manual override; icons are omitted for iOS compatibility.
notes.qx: Native host/ip rules with explicit policies. DOMAIN-REGEX is omitted; Surge-style no-resolve is not emitted. QX uses native domain/IP matching priorities. Single-label hostnames have no native switch.
notes.egern: Native YAML rule sets preserve domain regex and no_resolve. Requires a current Egern release with urls and flatten support.
